method: static read-only llvm-objdump --triple=thumbv7-linux-gnueabi; llvm-nm -D; llvm-readelf -rW; strings

findings.finding: MprIf::SetCallbackFunc(mediaId, fn, targetId, context) passes its reordered arguments to FEA at 0x450418.
MprCtrl::Init registers the legacy MprIf callback after MprIf::Init.
MprIfCallbackPoint invokes the resolved callback, then notifies IDs in inclusive range 0xc0000001..0xc0000091.
EventSwitcher filters callback entries by targetId and eventId and invokes matching entries.
EncodeStill reserves a slot, copies 0x40-byte RegionInfo descriptor, queues through vtable+0x20, and returns without waiting.
Slot exhaustion reports and returns immediate error 9.
0xc0000004 is the likely CBID_ENCODE_STILL because the literal and StillConverter callback names coexist, but no direct name-to-value code edge was found.
StillConverter's actual callback-table entry, receiver object, and handler invocation were not statically recovered.
Final pixel read, asynchronous cancellation semantics, and source/copy memory release are not proven.
Treating EncodeStill return 0 as encoding completion or pixel-read completion is contradicted by the immediate asynchronous return.

safety: No original firmware binary modified; no Ghidra project changed; no camera connected or flashed; SilentShutter is not declared functional.
